LESSON: WATER CONSERVATION (WAYS OF CONSERVING WATER, PRACTICE WATER CONSERVATION,)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: CONSERVATION OF RESOURCES Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested
Topic 1.2: Water conservation (ways of conserving water, practice water conservation,)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Water conservation (ways of conserving water, practice water conservation,), part of CONSERVATION OF RESOURCES Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How can we conserve soil water in household gardening practices?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Water conservation (ways of conserving water, practice water conservation,) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner is self-driven when practising various ways of conserving water in farming.

Values:
Responsibility: The learner exercises caution on the internet when using devices to search for information.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Environmental awareness: The learner cares for the environment by practising different ways of water conservation in the soil.

Link to other subjects:

● Science and Technology: The learner uses knowledge on conservation of water to conserve water in farming.

● Social studies: The learner applies knowledge on uses of water and effects of drought.

Suggested learning resources:

• Farm tools-jembes, pangas, shovels,

• Digital devices

• Print and non print media

• Mulching material- dry grass, leaves

• Shading material- sticks and twigs,
